_comment: Clek-compatible stroller fragment. Batch S8 (Thule). Sourced 2026-07-05. Thule Urban Glide 4-Wheel. Do NOT edit seed.json.
name: Thule Urban Glide 4-Wheel

clekListed.clekRow: Thule Urban Glide 4 — Thule Urban Glide universal car seat adapter (20110762)

brake.type: twist hand/running brake plus foot-operated parking brake
brake.power: twist-grip hand/running brake for controlled descents, plus a wrist safety strap (tether); foot-operated parking brake; front swivel wheels lock for higher speeds

capacity.minAgeOrNewborn: 6 mo+ for active use; birth with infant car seat via adapter or Thule bassinet

specs._capacityNote: Max child ~48.5 lb; total combined capacity rated 75 lb; large cargo basket 22 lb (10 kg) with zip-top cover.

safety.standards: Meets US ASTM F833 stroller standard — Clek's list confirms the UG4 was tested with the Liing and is ASTM-compliant for car seats on strollers.

recall.note: No recall found for the Thule Urban Glide line; the 2020 Thule stroller recall was limited to the Thule Sleek (handlebar detachment).

safety.notes: 5-point harness; twist hand brake; wrist safety strap; front swivel wheels lock for higher speeds; full-suspension.

specs.recline: multi-position recline to near-flat with built-in leg rest
specs.tires: air-filled tires; two front swivel/lockable ~10 in, two rear ~16 in (4-wheel)

notes: The 4-wheel variant of the current Urban Glide platform (~28.7 lb) — more stability than the 3-wheel UG3, heaviest of the Thule batch. Clek Liing attaches via the Urban Glide UNIVERSAL adapter 20110762 (adapter-20110762). Best cited price $599.93 (REI sale, reg $699.95; pre-order/ships within ~30 days); Thule DTC and Nature Baby Outfitter $799.95. A jogger/all-terrain stroller, not the light/compact city goal.
